notes: Round Viewer: overlay several rounds on one map, save clips, play a whole playlist (play all, next/previous, auto-advance, loop), Smart play that speeds through quiet stretches and slows for kills, storyboard of key moments, copy or save the map as an image, a shortcuts card (press ?), and pinned notes on the map. Notes ticked for the deck appear as a Coach notes slide. Restart the app after updating.
